summary: The protected implementation replaces the earlier versionless supplier-read boundary: PortableSupplierAdmissionState retains SupplierJournalV2 or SupplierJournalV3 through read, locked CAS and write. Existing /2 originals remain wire-only and preserve their untagged wire layout; beginIntentV3 explicitly selects /3 for a fresh original only. /3 remains /3 with empty, WireV1 or NativeProofV1 pending state. CAS refuses version changes, occupied-original replacement, loss or mutation of retained history, and pending removal without an exact same-kind nonce/digest disposition before writing. A single pending union and shared typed consumed/abandoned ledger reject cross-kind nonce replay; restart abandons either kind without renewing original command bounds. NativeProofV1 validates exact compact sorted ASCII C1 plus LF and ordinary raw SHA256 against a distinct caller-supplied context, command deadline and supplied host-lease bound. Host operation ID, reservation/proof/receipt joins and lease are caller assertions; this source does not authenticate them or infer them from CommandId, AllocationId or the latest wire head. Wire verification/acceptance explicitly rejects native pending values. Frozen protected-predecessor /2 pending and consumed/abandoned successors exercise byte-exact read/CAS compatibility; /3 empty/Wire/Native roundtrips, refusal, replay, restart, malformed record and digest-domain controls are in the cited tests. The cited protected predecessor schema dispatch does not recognize /3; the new tests retain its closed schema-dispatch control separately from runtime evidence. Execution/host /1 codecs, existing journal root/key/lock and source-write durability Unknown remain. Native proof acquisition, production nonce/clock/authentication policy, durable commit, ACK, host handoff, original effects, publication and installed acceptance remain separate holds. This supersession retains the historical version-loss finding at a235822e181dfb8e1aa42affaa1e7f734f2847d0 while replacing its pending implementation frontier; it grants no operation authority.
title: Supplier originals retain explicit journal versions with one typed pending slot
